subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Returns Processing
description: A quick win: understand Returns Processing.

hook.text: For every 100 online orders, 20–30 come back. Returns are the reverse supply chain nobody planned for.

buildup.text: Returns processing—inspect, sort, restock, refurbish, or dispose—is the hidden cost of e-commerce.

discovery.text: Fast returns processing gets products back on the shelf for resale before they lose value.

twist.text: Many returned items can't be resold. Clothing, electronics, and food often end up discounted or trashed.

climax.text: Returns cost US retailers over $800 billion a year. Efficient reverse logistics is now a survival skill.

punchline.text: Selling is half the job. Handling returns is the other half.

quiz.question: What is the average online return rate?
